# About `SAMPLE-baileys.cdx.json`

This is a **toolchain-validation sample**, not the production sidecar SBOM.

It was produced by running the *exact* command wired into
`baileys-sidecar-release.yml` —
`npx @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm@^1.19.0 --omit dev --output-format JSON` — against a
real Baileys-based project's lockfile (`vakalat-wa-baileys2`) to prove the toolchain
emits valid CycloneDX.

- Format: CycloneDX **1.4** JSON, valid `serialNumber`, 199 components with `purl`s.
- Tooling recorded in `metadata.tools`: `@cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm@1.20.0`.

The **real** per-release SBOM is generated by the release workflow against
`router/baileys-sidecar/package-lock.json` and published as a GitHub Release asset +
Paperclip work product at release time. It could not be generated in this build-out
because the FUL sidecar lockfile is not materialized in this execution workspace.
